allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: VIP Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board its meeting held today, i.e., Friday, September 18, 2026, has, inter alia, approved the proposal for raising funds for an aggregate amount not exceeding ₹ 500 crores (Rupees Five Hundred Crores) during FY 2026-27, in one or more tranches. allot.subject: General Updates
